ratio_gaps.why: a market value needs a share price and the number of shares; neither is part of a trial balance
a price-earnings ratio needs a share price
a per-share figure needs the number of shares
a payout ratio needs the dividends declared and the number of shares
a yield needs the dividends and a share price
the registry holds no cash-flow ratios; the cash flow statement is recorded but not wired into it
free cash flow needs operating cash flow and capital expenditure, which the registry does not define
an accruals ratio compares accounting profit with cash flow; it is not in the registry
a distress score needs five declared inputs, one of them a market value

needs: two consecutive periods for eight indices
ratio_gaps.why: a manipulation score needs two consecutive periods; one period is not enough
